title: chore(stories): remove jQuery stories
body:
Following https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/3190#issuecomment-433724609, we decided to remove the connectors + jQuery stories for maintainability and usefulness purpose.

These stories will get replaced by the new Algolia documentation.
